title: cerastium nodosum
intro: Cerastium nodosum, commonly known as nodding cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium nodosum include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
